claims.value: N. subfulva / N. nigricollis / C. rhodostoma
claims.evidence: Paper results: MSI of N. nigricollis, N. subfulva and C. rhodostoma glands; PRIDE organisms
Paper/PRIDE: fMSI (PLA2 substrate PC 16:0/22:6) of N. nigricollis gland; file name fmsi-n-moss
Protocol: Bruker Ultraflex III MALDI-TOF/TOF; PRIDE field says autoflex (protocol preferred)

limitations: PXD034174 is split into three SDRFs because it holds three unrelated assays: tryptic LC-MS/MS of venom gland section quarters (-tissue), intact-venom LC-MS of spat vs milked venom (-venom), and MALDI mass spectrometry imaging (-msi).
Each .wiff is claimed once; the companion .wiff.scan files are not listed as data files. imzML files (IMAGE DATA) are companions of the .ibd files; only .ibd (RAW category) are claimed.

File names say Nmoss/Nmos/n-moss (Naja mossambica); the paper and PRIDE name the animal Naja nigricollis (Tanzanian origin), so Naja nigricollis is used. n-mel is mapped to Naja subfulva (paper: non-spitting cobra N. subfulva; PRIDE organism list) - the abbreviation itself is not decoded by any deposited file.
Sex, age, developmental stage and strain are not reported and are not included.
Spatial resolution 50 um, m/z 1000-15000 linear (MSI) and 160-1400 reflectron (fMSI) are not encoded as columns.

comment[proteomics data acquisition method] column omitted and base template declared (instead of ms-proteomics) because no PRIDE:0000659 term fits this assay; ms-proteomics would require a false value.
fMSI is treated as the same gland as MSI (paper: same venom gland), biological replicate 1.
